title: What are the main events for today?
description: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, we don't have much on the agenda other than the Swiss PPI report. The data won't change anything for the SNB, so the market reaction will likely be muted.  The focus is currently on oil prices, with WTI and Brent both trading above the $100 level amid disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, Bab-el Mandeb and increased supply concerns after Saudi Arabia shut a key oil pipeline following drone attacks.  Looking ahead, the developments in the Middle East and the FOMC rate decision on Wednesday are going to be key for markets.  AMERICAN SESSION
